name: Furanylfentanyl
summary: An extremely potent opioid analgesic and analogue of fentanyl. There is extremely limited information about this drug. It is believed to be slightly less potent and shorter in duration than butyrfentanyl. Exercising extreme caution is strongly recommended.
advisory: Very potent opioid, be very careful while dosing.
doseBasis: NOTE: Very potent opioid, be very careful while dosing.
